node.title: 2c-gamma: diffuse budgets — scattered syzygies ARE face 2's lattice objects
node.statement: When the k+1 budget is spread over many small overlaps: the syzygy's dual codeword has SCATTERED support exactly covered by the intersection pattern — and counting constrained-support dual codewords and their linear relations is precisely Conjecture F's sparse-dual/closed-set lattice object. FACE 4's core meets FACE 2 here: the diffuse-stagnation count is an F-lattice count over the intersection-pattern flats. With faces 3+4 already sharing the spread residue and 2a consuming the list lane, ALL FOUR kernel faces are now pairwise connected through concrete shared objects — the kernel is one problem in the strongest possible sense. DECOMPOSED: gamma-a the transport dictionary (PROVABLE); gamma-b bounded syzygy dimension — the PROVED fixed-d lattice bound + the four-branch strip apply (proved reduction); gamma-c growing dimension — possible only when total overlap exceeds (m-1)k, and that regime IS face 2's f_many_sparse_structure (an identification, not new content: the F-residue and face 4's diffuse residue are the same node).
